result.summary: The intersection features basic pedestrian infrastructure including sidewalks, a signalized crossing, and a marked crosswalk. However, the crosswalk markings are significantly faded, and the wide street profile without curb extensions increases pedestrian exposure to traffic.

hazards.name: Faded crosswalk markings
hazards.description: The zebra-style crosswalk markings are heavily worn, reducing their visibility to approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground across the main roadway

hazards.name: Wide curb radius
hazards.description: The corner geometry appears wide, which can encourage higher vehicle speeds during right-hand turns.
hazards.location_in_image: Left foreground corner near the traffic signal

interventions.title: High-visibility crosswalk repainting
interventions.description: Refresh the crosswalk with high-visibility thermoplastic markings to improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Curb extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Install curb extensions to shorten the pedestrian crossing distance and slow down turning vehicles.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Program the traffic signal to give pedestrians a head start before vehicles get a green light.

result.summary: This wide, signalized intersection lacks essential pedestrian safety features such as marked crosswalks, curb ramps, and pedestrian signals. The absence of lane markings and the presence of cracked pavement further degrade the environment for those walking, despite the presence of sidewalks.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crosswalks
hazards.description: The intersection lacks any painted markings to designate pedestrian crossing areas, increasing exposure risk.

hazards.name: Lack of Curb Ramps
hazards.description: The absence of sloped transitions makes the intersection inaccessible for wheelchair users and difficult for others.

hazards.name: Wide Unmarked Roadway
hazards.description: The lack of lane markings on a wide street can lead to higher vehicle speeds and unpredictable lane positioning.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Paint continental-style crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian space and improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: ADA Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install tactile, sloped curb ramps at all crossing points to ensure accessibility.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Build out the sidewalk at corners to shorten crossing distances and slow turning traffic.

result.summary: This commercial street features sidewalks but lacks essential pedestrian crossing infrastructure at the signalized intersection, such as marked crosswalks and pedestrian signals. The wide, unmarked pavement and parked cars near the intersection further compromise safety by potentially increasing vehicle speeds and obscuring sightlines.

hazards.name: Missing Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: No painted markings exist to guide pedestrians or alert drivers to crossing locations at this signalized intersection.

hazards.name: Absence of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: Pedestrians lack dedicated signals to indicate when it is safe to cross, relying instead on vehicular lights.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstructions
hazards.description: Parked vehicles close to the intersection corners may block the view between pedestrians and approaching drivers.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install ladder-style crosswalk markings to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Add pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear crossing intervals.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs to reduce the crossing distance and improve visibility at the corners.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment features a marked zebra crosswalk and signalized control, providing a basic level of protection. However, the wide roadway width and presence of parked vehicles near the intersection corners create potential visibility issues and may encourage higher traffic speeds.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles on the right side of the street are positioned close to the crosswalk, potentially blocking the view between drivers and pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the roadway near the crosswalk

hazards.name: Wide Unmarked Roadway
hazards.description: The lack of lane markings on a relatively wide street can lead to higher speeds and unpredictable vehicle positioning.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and place pedestrians in a more visible position before they enter the travel lane.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces within 20-30 feet of the crosswalk to ensure clear sightlines for both pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Lane Markings
interventions.description: Add a center line and edge lines to narrow the perceived travel lane and encourage slower, more predictable vehicle speeds.
